description: On-chain AI inference marketplace on Solana devnet (Anchor 1.0). Providers register a name, task-type bitmask and QVAC DHT peer id; consumers later create escrowed jobs against an Ed25519-signed quote. This lab run verified provider registration and update.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration on the Blockchains/qvac-marketplace fork. The lab only changed declare_id / Anchor.toml to the Sol.College devnet program. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; fixes are offered upstream as ordinary pull requests and acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (register_provider, update_provider)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/qvac-marketplace/
QA: devnet proof of register_provider, update_provider, create_job, provider_complete, consumer_confirm, NameTooShort, and a rejected second register
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Stand up an Ed25519 quote and exercise create_job, provider_complete, consumer_confirm and refund_job on the lab devnet deploy
